name: Aabid Hussain Shaikh
title: Full Stack & Mobile Developer
bio: I architect scalable systems that solve real problems. 6+ years of shipping production code across web and mobile platforms.
aboutText: I started as a PHP developer, fell in love with Laravel's elegance, then expanded into Vue.js for reactive frontends. The mobile world called, and Flutter became my tool of choice for cross-platform apps. Today, I architect full-stack solutions that scale — from database design to deployment pipelines.

featuredProjects.name: E-Commerce Platform
featuredProjects.description: Multi-vendor marketplace with real-time inventory, payment gateway integration, and admin analytics dashboard.
highlights: Designed multi-tenant database schema isolating vendors by partition
Built real-time inventory sync using Laravel broadcasting + Vue reactivity
Integrated Razorpay with webhook reconciliation for settlement flows

featuredProjects.name: Social Platform
featuredProjects.description: Cross-platform social networking app with instant messaging, feed algorithm, and media sharing.
highlights: Custom feed ranking algorithm based on engagement recency + affinity scores
End-to-end encrypted messaging using Signal Protocol via libsignal
Media pipeline with on-device compression + CDN-backed delivery

featuredProjects.name: Analytics Dashboard
featuredProjects.description: Real-time data visualization platform with interactive charts, custom reporting engine, and role-based access.
highlights: Streaming data pipeline — WebSocket ingestion → aggregation → chart push in <200ms
Custom query builder UI that generates MongoDB aggregation pipelines visually
Role-based access with row-level filtering on every dashboard

featuredProjects.name: Healthcare Portal
featuredProjects.description: Patient management platform with appointment scheduling, EHR integration, and telemedicine support.
highlights: FHIR-compliant EHR integration layer normalizing 6+ provider formats
Redis-backed queue system for async video visit orchestration
Sub-second patient search across 500k+ records using Meilisearch
